node_purpose: Owner requests the 3+1 bounded corrections and permits one or two fresh Agent runs comparing thinking disabled/enabled. This is the first, thinking-disabled Dell Q1 Specialist run with approved frozen-case source navigation, Reviewed Evidence and S2 SQL. No Lead, Counter, Verifier, paid full chain, retry, resume or fallback.
input_scale_basis: R3 had 6 actual calls, 73,312 input and 2,577 output tokens. Frozen corpus is navigated on demand, with complete source blocks up to 80,000 characters per read and incremental SDK tool-message history. The 240,000-character input ceiling and 16,000-output-token allowance leave headroom for original context and source-linked Chinese workpaper without silent trimming.
required_outputs: a valid terminal Q1 Specialist workpaper or explicit typed stop
Chinese issuer-truth analysis linked to observed narrative sources and S2 facts
source-context quotations and concise claim rationales with authority and period caveats
counterevidence, unresolved data boundaries and what-would-change conditions
actual model turns, tools, usage, latency, LangSmith trace and private context/reasoning audit
schema_burden: One object-root action function, now five choices: request Evidence, request Finance, request Source, submit workpaper, or human review. Submission has free Chinese prose plus source IDs, exact source-passage quotes, authority notes and concise research rationales. Every structured response must be one valid action; format and material-source errors remain visible.
materiality_quality_risk: Wrong period, issuer, units and source context can invalidate an otherwise fluent answer. Accounting values should use S2 NumericFacts; source-only issuer orders, backlog and guidance require qualification and exact passage binding. Runtime acceptance proves structural binding only; human quality review separates model errors from local parser/data defects. No false financial quality PASS.
comparable_run_evidence: R3 ended bounded_handoff after 6 calls, 5 tool actions and 75,889 tokens, with no workpaper. Its failure exposed pre-top-k scope, instant/duration feedback and source-access defects. The implemented correction passed 213 targeted tests, including real frozen-data MCP, R3 query replay and SDK two-turn reasoning wire serialization. Those tests are not real model behavior proof.
reasoning_profile: DeepSeek V4 Pro thinking disabled, temperature 0, tool_choice auto with one structured action per decision. Prior SDK messages and tool observations persist within this one run; actual returned reasoning, if any, is privately preserved. The paired second run may change only thinking and its descriptive profile, with otherwise equal task, data, tools, code and budgets.
cost_and_latency_estimate: R3 observed 43.113 seconds aggregate model time and a LangSmith estimated USD 0.027727654, not a provider invoice. Additional source context can increase usage. Twelve rounds, eleven tool actions, 240 seconds per turn, 240,000 input characters and 16,000 output tokens per turn are anomaly stop ceilings, not completion targets or a promise to exhaust them. Record actual tokens, latency and trace estimate; do not cut required research merely for cost.
